title: Congress of Vienna: Vatican, monarchies and Knights of Malta organise against revolution

tellings.quote: So, afterwards, they colluded a thing called the Congress of Vienna.

plain: A man named Jason Samosa, on Jesse Michels's podcast, says that in 1815 the Vatican, the royal families of Europe and the Knights of Malta, an old Catholic order of knights, "colluded" in what was called the Congress of Vienna, a gathering of European powers led by the Austrian statesman Klemens von Metternich, to organise against revolution. He tells it as an early chapter in a story about a secret society, which he links to the hiding of UFO knowledge.
